en: A black and white aerial view photograph of a town dominated by a castle-like building surrounded by lush gardens, water features, and manicured paths. The postcard features the caption 'Bad Pyrmont. Schloß mit Kurhaus' at the bottom. The reverse side contains printed lines for address and message, a logo for the 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont,' and some handwritten and printed German text.
